The integration queue is expected to be non-functional: IntegrationAction and integrations.jsp use com.technoetic.xplanner.domain.Integration, which has no @Entity (the mapped entity is net.sf.xplanner.domain.Integration), so its HQL finds nothing and its save is expected to fail.

interpretation_corrections.correction: The sysadmin removal/re-add is gated by admin.edit.role on project 0: modifyRoles calls isCurrentUserAdminOfProject(0, user) and only then deletes the sysadmin association and re-adds it when systemAdmin=true.

DispatchForward checks projectId and read on system.project whenever authorization is required, which is the default (constructor sets isAuthorizationRequired=true); only an "@secure" forward could override it and none is declared. It is switched off by Spring property for projects, people, settings, dashboard, twikiformat and notAuthorized.
The WAP view actions are DispatchForward with authorization required, and the WML links pass only oid, so each view is expected to forward to the absent not-authorized page instead of rendering.

The projects list is filtered on the server while rendering: projects.jsp:32-48 removes projects without read permission (CollectionUtils.filter with SystemAuthorizer.hasPermission(..., "read")). Phase A said "no authorization check" for this list.
Phase A described the iCal feed and SOAP getCurrentIteration as working; Phase B found HQL property paths that the mapped entities do not have (see F-001).
